about: T-459 D: words under words -- once THE SUBTLE LAYER is held, a purple line after some people's lines, what is meant under what is said. The user chose four (2026-10-28): MOM's ship line, "Come back."; the CHECKPOINT's goodbye, "Not too soon."; CRYSTAL's "...further than I did", "I cannot always be there."; the CHAMPION's "I thought it would be you.", "Before you can." MOM, the CHECKPOINT and CRYSTAL are played here (T-502 moved CRYSTAL's line from PALLET's never-played rating scene to the lab, once the eighth MARK is held; T-504 keeps MOM's ship line only while the ship is in port); the CHAMPION's room is read from the ROM. The theatre's debug scratch save, never the user's.
